text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First supertankers arrive at Turkish Ceyhan terminal in preparation for carrying Iraqi crude oil
- King Hussein receives Iraqi foreign minister
- Iraq and Vietnam sign pact to expand cooperation in agricultural and commercial fields
- Health ministry completes preparations for the receipt of medical supplies
- Russia keen to have sanctions on Iraq completely lifted
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz receives Russian minister
- Zionist soldier killed in southern Lebanon
- Symposium on food industries starts today
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraq signs oil deals with European and American companies
- Iraq signs $20 billion deals for development of oilfields in north and south
- 30 foreign companies waiting to sign deals with Iraq
